description: Returns a spec's files, ready to write into a folder and build from: BUILD.md (how to build), spekkr.json (the manifest), spekkr.inputs.json (the person's choices) and the spec files. It checks the choices first and refuses a key the spec does not declare or a value it does not offer. Anything not chosen keeps the spec's default. It pulls the newest version unless version names another kept one. To bring a build of an earlier version up to date, call get_spec_changes first. With format, the files come laid out as a GitHub Spec Kit or a Kiro feature folder, and the answer says where they go and what to run next.

choices.description: The person's choices, by key from manifest.customize: any text for a setting, true or false for an option (on and off are taken too), one of its choices for a swap. For example {"database": "sqlite", "teams": false}. The answer and spekkr.inputs.json write an option as true or false, as the manifest writes its default.

format.description: The layout the files come in. Leave it out, or give spekkr, for a Spekkr folder. Give spec-kit for a GitHub Spec Kit feature folder, or kiro for a Kiro feature folder: when the person asks for one, or when the project already has a .specify folder (Spec Kit) or a .kiro folder (Kiro) and the person says yes when you offer it. The folder is the one dwrtz/spec-kit-codec or dwrtz/kiro-codec writes, so that codec turns it back into the Spekkr folder byte for byte.

version.description: A kept version to pull, like 1.4.0. Leave it out for the newest.

name: pull_spec
title: Pull a spec to build from
